text: The function $T:\real^n\to\real^m$ is a matrix transformation where $T(\xvec) = A\xvec$ for some $m\times n$ matrix $A$ if and only if $$ \begin{aligned} T(c\vvec) \amp {}={} cT(\vvec) \\ T(\vvec + \wvec) \amp {}={} T(\vvec) + T(\wvec)\text{.} \end{aligned} $$ . In this case, $A$ is the matrix whose columns are $T(\evec_j)$; that is, $$ A=\left[\begin{array}{rrrr} T(\evec_1) \amp T(\evec_2) \amp \ldots \amp T(\evec_n) \end{array}\right] $$ .
